model: Room Sensor RS485 BACnet (TES201, HTS201, CDS201)
applies_to: E+E Elektronik room sensors with RS485 BACnet MS/TP: TES201 (temperature), HTS201 (humidity/temperature) and CDS201 (CO2/humidity/temperature).
summary: The TES201, HTS201 and CDS201 are room sensors that report their measurements as BACnet MS/TP Analog Input objects. Which inputs exist depends on the model: temperature only, temperature plus humidity and dew point, or all of those plus CO2 (averaged and raw).
notes: Object list from the BACnet PICS 'Room Sensor RS485' (25.06.2021), sections 11-12. All objects are read-only except Present_Value while Out_Of_Service is true.
Temperature and dew point can be switched to °F or K; the object description changes with the unit (for example 'Temperature [deg. C]').
COV_Increment defaults to NaN, which disables COV reporting until a value is written.
The manual lists the device object name as model + 8 unique characters (e.g. HTS201_XXXXXXXX); it is writable.

points.name: TES201_XXXXXXXX / HTS201_XXXXXXXX / CDS201_XXXXXXXX
points.description: Device object; name = model + unique characters, instance set by the user

integration.summary: Give the sensor a unique device instance and MAC address, then poll or subscribe to the Analog Inputs for the model's measurements. Write a COV_Increment if you want COV notifications; it is off by default.
setup: Device object instance and name are writable and stored in non-volatile memory.
ReinitializeDevice is protected by a password given in the PICS.
gotchas: COV reporting stays disabled until COV_Increment is set to a real number.
Reliability turns to NO SENSOR if the measuring element is damaged or missing.
